boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Merced
boards.description: Ten named Merced food stops with directly documented late or around-the-clock availability; check the linked location page before leaving.

cards.title: Denny's on W 13th Street
cards.subtitle: 1128 W 13th St, Merced
cards.notes: Use the restaurant page to confirm service before heading out; it lists this Merced Denny’s as open 24 hours and offers takeout.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock diner option with documented all-day service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its restaurant at 1128 W 13th St in Merced as open 24 hours, with breakfast all day, lunch and dinner, walk-ins, and takeout.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists this restaurant as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on V Street
cards.subtitle: 1400 V Street, Merced
cards.notes: Check the listed location details before going; its official page shows a drive-thru and 24-hour operation every day.
cards.short_summary: A V Street drive-thru listed for 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr. lists its 1400 V Street, Merced location as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and identifies a drive-thru among its store features.
cards.access_notes: Official location hours state open 24 hours every day; a drive-thru is listed.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on W Olive Avenue
cards.subtitle: 300 W Olive Ave, Merced
cards.notes: Plan for a before-midnight stop and verify the location page on the day; the official locator lists a midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: An Olive Avenue quick-service option listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr.'s official Merced location information identifies the restaurant at 300 W Olive Ave and lists it as closing at midnight.
cards.source_title: Carl's Jr. — 300 W Olive Ave, Merced
cards.access_notes: The official location listing states that this restaurant closes at midnight.

cards.title: Yum Yum Donuts on G Street
cards.subtitle: 2931 G St, Merced
cards.notes: Use the online-order or call option if needed; the location page lists 24-hour access plus coffee, sandwiches, and in-store seating.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour G Street bakery and sandwich counter.
cards.evidence_claim: Yum Yum Donuts lists its 2931 G St, Merced shop as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and describes coffee, sandwiches, takeout, and in-store seating.
cards.source_title: Yum Yum Donuts — 2931 G St, Merced
cards.access_notes: Official location hours list the shop as open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1270 V St
cards.title: Jack in the Box at 1270 V Street
cards.subtitle: 1270 V St, Merced
cards.notes: For a late pickup, use the drive-thru rather than assuming the lobby is open; the location page separately lists both schedules.
cards.short_summary: A V Street stop whose drive-thru runs later than its lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 1270 V St location's drive-thru as open until 4:00 a.m. and its lobby as open until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1270 V St, Merced
cards.access_notes: Official page: drive-thru until 4:00 a.m.; lobby until 10:00 p.m. Check day-specific hours.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 77 S Parsons Ave
cards.title: Jack in the Box on S Parsons Avenue
cards.subtitle: 77 S Parsons Ave, Merced
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for late service and confirm the day's schedule first; the official listing distinguishes it from the earlier-closing lobby.
cards.short_summary: A south Merced drive-thru documented through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 77 S Parsons Ave location's drive-thru as open until 4:00 a.m. and its lobby as open until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 77 S Parsons Ave, Merced
cards.access_notes: Official page: drive-thru until 4:00 a.m.; lobby until 10:00 p.m. Check day-specific hours.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 595 W Olive Ave
cards.title: Jack in the Box on W Olive Avenue
cards.subtitle: 595 W Olive Ave, Merced
cards.notes: Confirm the drive-thru schedule before setting out; this named W Olive location is listed by the chain as a late-night service option.
cards.short_summary: A W Olive Avenue location with around-the-clock drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 595 W Olive Ave, Merced location's drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 595 W Olive Ave, Merced
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the drive-thru as open 24 hours; verify same-day conditions.

cards.title: Taco Bell on G Street
cards.subtitle: 3140 G Street, Merced
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes, and confirm the date-specific schedule; Friday and Saturday are listed later than other nights.
cards.short_summary: A G Street drive-thru with listed service into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 3140 G Street as until 2:30 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and until 3:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 2:30 a.m. Sun–Thu and 3:00 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 1440 Martin Luther King Jr Way
cards.title: Taco Bell on Martin Luther King Jr Way
cards.subtitle: 1440 Martin Luther King Jr Way, Merced
cards.notes: This is a drive-thru late stop rather than a late dining-room plan; review the official page for the specific night’s closing time.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option listed until 1 or 1:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 1440 Martin Luther King Jr Way as until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1440 Martin Luther King Jr Way, Merced
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 1:00 a.m. Sun–Thu and 1:30 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Yosemite Parkway
cards.subtitle: 1990 Yosemite Parkway, Merced
cards.notes: Make this a drive-thru pickup after 10 p.m.; the official location page lists midnight drive-thru service every day and earlier dine-in hours.
cards.short_summary: A Yosemite Parkway drive-thru listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 1990 Yosemite Parkway as 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. every day, while dine-in hours end earlier.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 12:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end earlier.
